meta.title: Contact: book a process review | Intello
meta.description: Tell us which process you want to review. We set up a 30-minute conversation and send you back a process map.

header.title: Start with
header.lede: Tell us which process you want to review. We reply by email to set up a 30-minute conversation.

form.requiredNote: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.

hints.message: Which process it is, its rough volume and what you want to improve. Between 10 and 4000 characters.

privacy.before: We use your name, company, email, phone and message only to answer your enquiry. More in our

name.tooShort: Your name must be at least 2 characters.

company.tooLong: The company name is too long.

email.invalid: Enter a valid email, for example name@company.com.

phone.tooLong: The phone number is too long.

message.tooShort: Tell us a little more (at least 10 characters).
message.tooLong: The message is too long (4000 characters at most).

token.body: Check your details and send it again. No message was sent.

expired.title: The form expired
expired.body: Check your details and send it again. No message was sent.

used.title: This message was already sent
used.body: We already received your enquiry. There is no need to send it again.

sent.title: Message sent
sent.body: Thank you. We received your enquiry and will reply by email.

failed.body: Your details are still in the form. Try again in a few minutes or call us on

steps.title: We reply
steps.body: We email you to set up a 30-minute conversation.

steps.title: We review one process
steps.body: We look at its volume, your systems and the pain points.

steps.title: You get a map
steps.body: A process map with a draft SOP, RACI and metrics, and a private proposal.
